reference_sql:
SELECT parent_category, country_code,
       COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS n_orders,
       COUNT(DISTINCT product_id) AS n_products,
       SUM(units) AS units_sold
FROM sales
WHERE order_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-12-01' AND DATE '2024-12-31'
GROUP BY parent_category, country_code
ORDER BY parent_category, country_code
alternatives: SELECT parent_category, country_code, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS n_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT product_id) AS n_products, SUM(units) AS units_sold FROM sales WHERE order_date >= DATE '2024-12-01' AND order_date < DATE '2025-01-01' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2
